intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independent, complex photographic test of the assigned aeolian dune wind structure keyword, use the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference, and make the environmental structure primary enough for strict pixel review.

A photorealistic 28 mm environmental editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult documentary traveler, whose general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural skin texture draw only from the attached appearance reference, standing on a firm interdune flat at the lower left of a coastal barchan field at dawn. The complete dune system dominates the frame: a long gentle windward stoss slope covered in fine transverse ripples rises to a crisp sinuous crest, while a steep lee slipface drops beyond it. A crosswind pulse drives ribbons of saltating sand up the stoss slope, over the crest, and into a small granular avalanche down the slipface. The traveler faces camera in three-quarter view, holding a saffron wind streamer and compact field notebook; her visible face remains unobstructed while her figure occupies about one fifth of the image. Low amber crosslight grazes the ripples, thinning sea fog layers the distant dark escarpment, and airborne grains catch the light. Natural documentary color, wind-realistic fabric and hair motion, deep environmental scale, high spatial legibility.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
